mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ROOM ( ADMIN_IDX, ROOM_NAME, ROOM_LEVEL, ROOM_INFO, ROOM_PRICE, ROOM_PEOPLE, ROOM_IMAGE, ROOM_MEMO ) VALUES ( #{adminIdx}, #{roomName}, #{roomLevel}, #{roomInfo}, #{roomPrice}, #{roomPeople}, #{roomImage}, #{roomMemo} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ROOM WHERE ADMIN_IDX = #{adminIdx} ORDER BY ROOM_IDX DESC
